buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added Text Based ATC i. Bidders are required to submit EMD Rs. 2,07,900/- in favour of Munitions India Limited O. F. Khamaria. Exemption will be given to the sellers as defi ned at Para m of GeM GTC 4.0 (Version 1.28) dated 22.12.2025. or latest v ersion of GeM. Bidder should have registered in major NIC code “49223” f or (rented vehicle with driver) in Udyam Registration Certificate for EM D exemption. EMD/PSD may be accepted in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft, Fixed

Deposit Receipt, Banker's Cheque or Bank Guarantee from any of the commer cial banks and it should be drawn in the favor of CGM or payment online in an acceptable form and the same shall be uploaded by seller in the online bid an d hard copy of the same instrument (except online payment) will have to be s ubmitted directly to the buyer within following time limit: (#) Hard copy of the EMD (Bid security) will have to be submitted directly to the buyer within 5 working days of bid opening, failing which the bid may be tr eated as incomplete & may lead to rejection of the bid by buyer without makin g any reference to the seller. (#) Hard copy of the Performance security deposit (PSD) will have to be submit ted directly to the buyer within 30 days of award of contract on GeM Portal. It is advised that EMD may be submitted through online payment in favor of be neficiary details as given below to avoid postal delays & bank formalities asso ciated with generation and submission of instruments other than online payme nt. If the seller submits the EMD through online payment mode, then seller shal l upload the documentary proof of online payment of EMD along with online bid submission. Further it is also advised that PSD may be submitted through online payment mode after award of contract on GeM Portal in favor CGM, beneficiary details a s given below, and also Indemnity Bonds may be accepted as performance sec urity deposit from central/State PSUs. If seller submit the PSD through online p ayment mode, then seller shall upload the documentary proof of online payme nt of PSD at GeM Portal. Munitions India Limited O F Khamar Account Name : ia Account No. : 40436892598 IFSC : SBIN0003228 MICR : 482002006 Bank address : STATE BANK OF INDIA, RANJHI In case of any clarification bidder can enquire through e-mail i.e. ofkpvgrp8@ord.g ov.in OR call at 0761-2742137. ii. Firm must have executed at least one supply order of minimum Rs. 55,44,0 00.00 or two supply order of Rs. 34,65,000.00 or three supply order of Rs. 27,72,000.00 for providing similar service to any Central Government/State Government or Public Sector Undertaking in the last 03 years. Relevant doc uments i.e. copy of Contract Order and Execution Certificate/Job Completio n Certificate are to be uploaded by the bidder along with bid (MSEs & Start ups are exempted). iii. Average annual turnover of the bidder for the last 03 years ending on 31st March of preceding year (2026) must be at least Rs. 20,79,000.00. Bidders shall submit Certificate from registered CA indicating the turnover details fo r last 3 years (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) along with bid in support of fin ancial capability. (MSEs & Startups are exempted). iv. Although local presence of Jabalpur District Area is not strictly necessary b ut for operational emergencies, the successful bidder has to open a local o perational office within 15 to 30 days of the award of contract. Registered o ffice address indicated in relevant certificate issued by GST/NSIC/KVIC/DIC/E PF/ office of Labour commissioner/ESIC, will be considered as valid proof of registered office at Jabalpur District Area. v. In case of any clarification bidder can enquire through e-mail i.e.ofkpvgrp8 @ord.gov.in OR call at 0761-2742137. vi. Service Provider shall comply the Scope of Work and Terms and Co

nditions uploaded along with bid. Bidder should submit/upload the sealed and signed copy of scope of work and SLA along with the bi d, if the bidder not submit the same their offer will be rejected. vii. Service Provider shall provide Uniform to the drivers (khaki pant and shirt a nd black shoes uniform along with name plate depicting firm’s name) and t he contract value shall be including the cost of Uniforms. viii. Driver must keep original license while on duty. ix. Payment terms, Penalty Clause, Extra KM charge & Extra Hours Ch arge-As per GeM SLA. x. Bidders should submit latest copy of registration certificates of MSME certif icate along with bid. xi. Bidders should submit copy of registration certificates of EPF & ESIC along with bid. xii. Bidder should submit the sealed & signed copy of scope of work and terms & conditions. xiii. Note to Bidders – Participating bidders may please be noted that GeM Por tal is having functionality to monitor bids having same IP address used by b idders / sellers. GeM portal is capturing and reflecting the IP address used b y buyers and participated bidders / sellers. The received bids having matchi ng / common IP address with other participating bidders / sellers or buyer, t hen their offer will be out rightly rejected and will not be considered for furt her evaluation. xiv. Sub-contracting/Sub-letting with the permission of the buyer: Seller shall not be entitled without buyers prior return consent to sub contract/sub -let to a third party all or part of the benefits or obligations of the contract ( Even by way of change of ownership or control), except as expressly permit ted in this contract if any, to subcontract any of its right and interest under this contract. xv. Bidders has to submit Near- relationship certificate that none of his/her rela tive is working in the Unit where he/she is going to bid for the tender. “The Bidder/Tender shall disclose whether any relative of the bidder /tenderer, it proprietor, partner director or person having a controlling or material intere st in the firm is employed with or associated with the procuring entity. Near relative shall mean a person related by blood, marriage or legal relationship , including spouse, father, mother, son, daughter, brother, sister and such o ther relatives as may be specified under the applicable rules of the procurin g entity. The Bidder/Tenderer shall submit a declaration conforming above. Any non-disclosure or incorrect declaration may be dealt with in accordance with the applicable tender conditions and rules of procuring entity”. xvi. Service provider have to follow recently implemented four labour codes effective from 21st Nov. 2025. xvii. The person being deploy should have PVR (Police Verification Report) which is valid for 01 years. xviii. The person being deploy should have Aadhar card linked with mobile no. xix. Extra KM charge & Extra Hours Charge-As per GeM SLA. xx. Bidders has to comply any other term & condition as me ntioned in buyer ad ded ATC and GeM SLA. xxi. Price of the Contract will be firm & fixed and no escalation in the c ontract value shall be entertained. Bidder should quote price keepi ng in mind for revision of minimum wages for driver during executi on of supply order if any. xxii. Bidders offer is liable to be rejected if they don’t upload any of the docume nts/certificates sought in the tender along with the bid.

xxiii. Payment Terms :- Work completion certificate will be issued as per actual utilization of vehicle on monthly basis. Accordingly payment will be done. xxiv. Other payment terms as per buyer added ATC and GeM SLA. xxv. Termination & Penalty Clause :- As per buyer added ATC and as pe r GeM SLA. In case of multi L-1 offers, “Run L-1 Selection” tool provided by GeM system may b e used and the contract will be awarded to GeM system selected L-1 firm with existin g terms & conditions. . 2.
